messages:
Nina (PM): Quick user report: on narrow screens the billing 'Download CSV' and 'View invoices' buttons get squished under the spend legend. Users expect invoice actions to be persistent. Screenshot: https://files.internal/redwood/squished-ctas.png

Beck (Designer): Thanks. My initial thought: move invoice CTAs to the left of the chart as a sticky header row, and make the legend collapsible into a compact "Top tokens" pill on small widths. Sketch in figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/billing-compact-legend

Jules (Frontend): Sticky header is doable but watch stacking context with the console nav; also sticky elements affect keyboard focus order. If CTAs are visually sticky they still need to be first in DOM for screen readers (Marco pls confirm).

Marco (Billing): Agreed — CTAs must be keyboard reachable immediately. Also request: keep the invoice download format consistent (CSV includes token-type id, project id, cost_usd). We had a support case where CSV lacked project id and created confusion.

Priya (Analytics): If we collapse legend into a "Top tokens" pill we should show the breakdown tooltip on hover and allow expand to full modal listing. For analytics: add a data-test-id on the expanded list so our ML cost reports can hook into it for sampling.

Beck (Designer): Alternate responsive: for widths <=800px show only the top-2 tokens inline with a "+N more" pill. For super-narrow (<420px) convert to a single kebab menu that opens a panel. I'll update mocks with annotations for keyboard and screen reader hints.

Jules (Frontend): Implementation notes:
- add aria-haspopup and aria-controls to the pill/menu
- ensure Escape closes the panel and focus returns to trigger
- keep invoice CTAs as <button class="primary"> first in DOM, visually left of chart on narrow screens
I can prototype in the storybook sandbox and flag cross-browser sticky issues.

Marco (Billing): Also call out contrast: primary CTA must meet 4.5:1 on collapsed backgrounds. We have a few themes where the background is slightly darker and the current green fails AA. Will share theme tokens.

Priya (Analytics): Regarding "top by" sorting: prefer default "by spend USD" but allow users to switch to "by tokens" via a mini toggle in the expanded panel. We'll need to persist preference in localStorage or query param for reproducibility.

Nina (PM): Nice. Action list: @Beck update figma with top2 + +N + kebab states and annotate a11y hints, @Jules prototype storybook with keyboard/focus behaviors and sticky header, @Marco share theme color tokens and CSV schema required, @Priya add analytics hooks and sample payload. Sync Monday 10am PT to review prototype.

Jules (Frontend): noted. I'll open a draft PR with the sandbox story and wire up the feature-flag (compactLegendV2) so we can turn on for internal users first.
